decisions.reason: The mechanical impact is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including the battery JST location and both JST orientations; no additional or corrected Event is required.
Connector placement and orientation do not change the battery protection, cutoff, or thermal-protection requirements.
The battery JST layout decision does not alter the charge-status indication path or separate-LED policy.
Battery connector placement and orientation do not change ESP32 clock, sleep, or wake behavior.
The source decision does not change the switched 5V rail's converter, enable control, default state, or operating pattern.
The battery and board JST arrangement does not affect I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
Specifying the battery JST's location and L-shaped orientation does not revise the existing sourceability or compatible-alternative policy.
The connector layout decision leaves the established three-board system architecture unchanged.
